rows.text: Everybody’s missing Tao’s whole point. Imagine an AI-generated cancer drug that’s specifically designed to game the drug trial process. We *already* see AI behave like that when confronted with difficult programming/hacking challenges. This is already reality.

rows.text: The power grid just became the AI bottleneck. Amazon's answer is Project Falcon. Now the utility can switch the sites to backup power on its own, without contacting AWS. rows.author: CNBC
rows.name: CNBC
rows.text: Artificial intelligence is now used by almost 90% of legal professionals in the U.K. and Ireland, and it’s putting one of the profession’s oldest conventions — the billable hour — under the microscope. That’s according to legal software company Clio’s U.K. & Ireland Legal Insights Report 2026. It found that among firms using AI, almost 80% said they can handle more work without increasing resources, while over 70% said it cut costs by absorbing administrative work once done by support staff. Read more: https://t.co/QT7W1ohvhZ
